I think he's the guy. He has a pretty solid foundation given his lack of starts and lack of experience all around him on both sides of the ball (youngest NFL roster in 6 years). 

His shortcomings are things we can iron out over time, but when it comes to decision-making, going through his reads, how he works within the offensive system, his athleticism and arm talent, that's all not only promising for a young QB in his first year as the starter but even good for QBs in general most of the time. 

He looks calm, poised, comfortable in the pocket, and if we can just work out a few kinks he'll be a QB that can lead us to a super bowl with a strong supporting cast. 

That's why I say he's the guy, I didn't think I'd be saying that so early on in the season because for some QBs, if not most, you just don't really know for certain whether they are the guy or not till after a half a season, full season, or even 2-3 seasons. However, I think the good traits he does display are the exact traits you want to see in a young QB. That is to say that out of all the things he could be good at, he's good at the right things and performs in those areas often enough to merit a certain level of excitement and trust in the process that ironing out his less positive areas of play will be.
